abstract:
The equilibrium constant for the formation of carbamate from monoethanolamine was evaluated at various
temperatures of 298, 308, 318, and 328 K and ionic strengths up to 1.7 M. From the plot of log10K versus I0.5, the variation of the thermodynamical constant with temperature follows the relationship log10K1 =
−0.934 + (0.671 × 103)K/T.
